title: Bag of Bricks - Blue 27
descriptionHtml:
Blue — colour 27

The dependable everyday blue. Neither vivid nor dark, it covers open sky and calm water reliably, and makes a safe background choice when the subject is doing the work.

Works well with: Shiny Blue 05, Stone Blue 18, White 37

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Blue bricks (colour 27) for Memobrick mosaics. A clean everyday blue for skies, water and dependable background coverage.
